message: not applied: `{card}` is not a card this simulator reads
description: The card is recognised as a dot-card but has no meaning here, so the deck runs as if it were not there. Cards in this group include `.step` (the deck runs once, at the values written), `.meas` (nothing is measured), `.param` and `.func` (the names are not defined), `.lib` (nothing is loaded) and `.title`.
actions: If the card matters to the result, rewrite the deck without it: one run per `.step` value, values written literally instead of `.param` names, `.include` instead of `.lib`, and measurements taken from the printed output.
Leave it if the deck is shared with another simulator and the card does not affect what you read here.
